answer_1.quote: Evaluating the factuality of long-form LLM responses is a challenging task, since the facts in these outputs tend to be longer and more complicated, requiring a broader inter-sentence context for accurate assessment.

answer_2.quote: We report three key factual evaluation metrics: (i) Precision measures the proportion of correct facts among all extracted facts. (ii) Recall assesses the proportion of reference facts that are covered by the model response, and (iii) F1 balances precision and recall in factual evaluation.

answer_3.quote: To automate the detection of incomplete and missing facts, we employ three LLMs (GPT-4o, Llama 3.3-70B, Qwen 2.5-32B) to replicate the annotation process followed by human annotators.
methods: detection of incomplete and missing facts

answer_4.quote: We employ four annotators, all fluent English speakers with relevant research experience in fact-checking, to identify incomplete and missing facts from all 451 extracted facts, with each fact independently annotated by all four.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to determine whether a fact is incomplete and, if so, specify the subcategory of incompleteness... Each annotator then checks these 'missing spans' to determine if they indicate a temporal or contingency relation.
